item.title: Lakera Guard Expands Content Moderation Capabilities to Protect Your AI Applications and Users
item.description:
Tags: ["Content Moderation", "Artificial Intelligence", "Machine Learning", "Cybersecurity", "Software Solutions"]
Summary:
  • Lakera Guard is a content moderation solution for AI applications.
  • It detects and filters harmful AI-generated content.
  • The platform targets hate speech, harassment, and misinformation.
  • It uses AI and machine learning for real-time moderation.
  • Lakera Guard supports customizable policies and scalable infrastructure.
  • It helps organizations maintain compliance and user trust.
